summary: LEGION-107 round 1 is clean. keyFindings.description: resend-ledger.ts row says 'stores and logs no payload' while the ledger key is topic + verbatim payload for the TTL; only 'logs no payload' is true (the module's own doc is right). Fast-follow wording.

settle() doc says 'once the re-send has fired'; it runs after the pause and before the re-probe/controlDirective (settling early is the safe choice against a throwing natsRequest stranding the in-flight mark). Fast-follow wording.

Robustness, no observable change: a handleException sitting in its pre-ledger probe when dispose() runs arms one 5 s pause (ledger already cleared, so always attempt 1) that drain() waits out, then the disposed guard returns and nothing is sent. Suggest `if (this.disposed) return;` before resendLedger.claim() per the armIdleRetire convention. Fast-follow.
controlDirective's `| false` arm has only a test caller. Fast-follow.
Four-line queue-join tail duplicated between enqueueClaimForLaunch and enqueueIdleWorker; P14's fake receiver has an unreachable keyless- branch. Fast-follow.

thermo: thermonuclear-deep-review and thermonuclear-code-quality are not installed in this profile; two `reviewer` agents ran the thermo briefs once at d13ea8c9. 0 Blocking. One P2 (dispose during the pre-ledger probe) downgraded with reasoning (5 s bound, nothing sent, ms-wide window); one P3 (tree status re-check after the pause) refuted (rootForIssue has no status filter, pre-pause path is identical to main).
observations: Pre-LEGION-108 listener: a busy worker's delivery_failed reaches resumeWorker -> workerCatchup (four gh api --paginate subprocesses per PR artifact) on every exception before the catch-up is enqueued silently; state stays bounded (one queue entry, zero worker-queued) and the daemon re-sends nothing to a worker, so the rate is the actual message rate. The spec's own 'one silent catch-up' consequence; recorded, not a finding.
The implementer's open question (keep LEGION-103's worker-side guard) is the architect's call; the shipped behaviour follows the plan and spec.
fastFollow: resend-hardening-and-wording: the this.disposed guard before resendLedger.claim(), the AGENTS.md 'stores no payload' wording, the settle() doc, the test-only `| false` arm of controlDirective, the duplicated queue-join tail, and P14's dead keyless- branch; one PR after this merges.
